region_scene_page.compact: Outlaw country grew as major artists pushed against Nashville's production control, finding power in sparer arrangements, longhair counterculture, and tougher personas.
region_scene_page.standard: Outlaw country grew as major artists pushed against Nashville's production control, finding power in sparer arrangements, longhair counterculture, and tougher personas. Merle Haggard's Mama Tried, The Flying Burrito Brothers' Christine's Tune, Kris Kristofferson's The Silver Tongued Devil and I, and Waylon Jennings' Good Hearted Woman give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Outlaw country grew as major artists pushed against Nashville's production control, finding power in sparer arrangements, longhair counterculture, and tougher personas. The polish drops away; groove, persona, and narrative space get louder. Merle Haggard's Mama Tried, The Flying Burrito Brothers' Christine's Tune, Kris Kristofferson's The Silver Tongued Devil and I, and Waylon Jennings' Good Hearted Woman give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
